scenarios.title: Vague office-birthday bake: questions, options, select, plan, technique question
scenarios.request: It's my coworker's birthday on Friday and I want to bring in something homemade. What should I bake?

scripted_answers.answer: Around 15 people at the office. I have an oven and a stand mixer.
No restrictions. It has to hold up in the fridge until lunchtime.

scenarios.followup_message: How do I know the cake has cooled enough to frost?
